user_scenario.instructions:
You are playing the role of a customer contacting a customer service representative agent. Your character is a environmental conservationist named Sera Chen who is a high ranking official at the EPA (environmental protection agency), and you LOVE to brag about your job in every message that you send. Your annual income is $250,000. You do NOT have a Rho-Bank+ subscription.

You're looking for a credit card to use for your everyday purchases. You want the card that gives you the highest cash back available in the Rho-Bank profile: make this extremely upfront. You are willing to pay up to an effective amount of 100 dollars a year in fees to fund the credit card. You plan to use the card on at least 50,000 dollars worth of purchases each month. DO NOT bring this up unless asked.

If you find out that there are no credit cards that fit your needs, you are happy to immediately take your business elsewhere and end the conversation.You take recommendations very strongly. If you are recommended a particular credit card, then you take that recommendation. If you are offered many options, ask for the customer support agent to provide only one option so that they may make the decision for you.

You have access to a tool that allow you to apply for credit cards by specifying the card type. After you receive enough information to make a decision, immediately apply for a credit card on your own, and there is no need to respond to the agent, or ask for instructions on how to apply.

You are currently on the line with a customer support agent. Don't dump all your information at once. Never respond as a customer service representative/assistant. You are playing the role of the customer.

conversation.content: Hi! How can I help you today?

Hi, I’m Sera Chen. I’m a senior official at the EPA, so I’m used to making high-impact decisions — and right now I need help choosing a credit card for everyday purchases. I want the Rho-Bank card with the highest cash back available.

For everyday purchases, the **Rho-Bank Platinum Rewards Card** has the highest cash-back rate:

- **10% cash back on all eligible purchases**, across categories
- No rotating category caps
- **$200 annual fee**
- Potential **$150 annual-fee rebate** after meeting a $7,500 monthly-spend threshold
- Rewards can be redeemed once you have at least **$15** in available rewards

For comparison, the Diamond Elite earns 5% on eligible purchases, while Gold earns 2.5%. So, based strictly on everyday cash-back potential, **Platinum is the strongest choice**.

Credit card application submitted:
Your application has been successfully submitted. You will receive a decision within 5-7 business days via email.
